direction: Upgrade existing Keepfall in phases; preserve all current progress.

phase1.notes: Original levels remain intact. Rank studs distinguish levels within a model stage. Shared texture atlases, original-art fallback, existing building footprints.

alreadyImported: Toon RTS: footman, archer, worker and peaceful job animations
Four Evil Dragons: all four species and their supported color choices

changes: Use wooden houses for builder huts and town residences.
Use tavern exterior and barrel/storage props for existing Brewery and Cellar art, retaining Ale and building IDs.
Assemble castle and wall upgrade appearances from the modular castle kit.
Add the windmill as scenery initially, without inventing another resource.
recommendedNext.checks: Strip unseen interiors, resolve Unity material references, preserve footprints and collision paths, verify mixed-level layouts.

changes: Use heavy infantry for existing knights and model-based soldiers for guards.
Use additional worker variants to distinguish civilian jobs.
Consider spearmen, priests and cavalry as later additions only after defining roles and balance.
recommendedNext.checks: Preserve existing army counts, hero levels, troop IDs and replay rules. Test a full battle at the actual mobile camera scale.

changes: Build 3D ground, roads and forests around the existing build grid.
Use castle ruins and the mage tower as raid landmarks or future encounter scenery.
Enable a rotating camera only once the painted scenery and remaining billboards have suitable replacements.
recommendedNext.checks: Retain scenery unlocks and building positions. Gates must not silently change existing wall pathing. Unity shaders and particle systems need web equivalents.

preserve: Profile identity and current local/remote save namespaces
Building IDs, types, levels, positions, construction and upgrade timers
Gold, Ale, resource production timestamps and claim bookkeeping
Armies, training queues and hero levels
Four hatcheries, unique species choices, colors and individual levels
Glory, shields, raids, defense history and historical replay rules
migrationPolicy: Phase 1 changes only rendering and assets; no save migration or reset is required. Future schema changes must preserve an original copy and use a versioned, repeatable migration with profile-isolation tests.
excludeFromGameImport: Unity editor tutorials and TextMesh Pro editor resources
TimmyRobot, platforming starter assets and sci-fi audio unless a separate use is requested
Duplicate prefab color variants as separate gameplay buildings
